purpose: Emphasize degree or ask formally about a method.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
いかに + predicate; いかに … か; いかに … ても
I learned how important preparation is.
However much we hurry, we will not make it.
The challenge is how to protect resources.
formation: いかに + predicate; いかに … か; いかに … ても
restrictions: Often occurs in reflection, explanation, or concession.
mistake: Match the ending to the meaning: か asks degree; ても concedes it.
